text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4492 fired: `queue.backlog.high` for service=production-inference (hosted). threshold=queue_length>1200 for 5m. Impacting generation endpoints, latency and 503s increasing. Auto-escalation to @eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created PD-4492 | Urgency: high | Assigned: eng-oncall | Pager: @arya

arya: acked on PD. I'm on it. first look - which pool is hitting backlog?

mike: looks like inference-prod-main-pool. Autoscaler metrics show low observed scaling actions for last 10m.

sophia: grabbing HPA / autoscaler controller logs now. could be cooldown or model-packing causing slow scale.

kevin: I'm seeing HPA target CPU ~80% but replicas stuck at 24 while target should be ~120 based on queue. suspect scale limiter.

sophia: pasted autoscaler status:
```
$ redwoodctl autoscaler status --pool inference-prod-main
pool: inference-prod-main
desired_replicas: 118
current_replicas: 24
scale_state: scale_locked
lock_reason: headroom_estimate_zero_division
lock_since: 2025-06-02T03:12:05Z
```

mike: whoa headroom_estimate_zero_division. that's not good. @devops-bot any recent rollout to autoscaler logic?

devops-bot: Deploy event: autoscaler-service v2.1.3 promoted to prod at 2025-06-02T02:45Z by ci-bot. No rollbacks.

arya: it's likely the v2.1.3 change to headroom calc introduced a division edge-case. we need immediate mitigation: 1) manual scale up, 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model for low-tier traffic, 3) rollback or patch.

priya: I'll take manual scale and routing changes. @mike can you own the autoscaler rollback/patch?

mike: on it. quick plan: revert autoscaler to v2.1.2, disable the problematic headroom calc flag, then redeploy v2.1.3 with fix. rolling restart will take ~10-15m.

sophia: manual scale command to run:
```
redwoodctl scale pool inference-prod-main --replicas 140 --reason "emergency surge: PD-4492"
```
will push more nodes, need to watch infra quotas.

kevin: infra quotas check: we have room for +130 GPUs in the us-west region. safe to scale.

priya: running manual scale now.

priya: output:
```
Scaling pool inference-prod-main -> 140 replicas
Queued: provisioning 116 new workers
Current: 24 -> 140 (in progress)
```

arya: good. also apply routing change to divert non-premium customers to smaller model (reduce cost and lower memory pressure):
```
redwoodctl route update --from /v1/generate --match customer_tier!=premium --to model:smaller-quant
```

priya: routing update applied. Confirmed: 37% of incoming requests now hitting smaller-quant model.

mike: starting autoscaler rollback to v2.1.2. patch PR opened to fix zero-division guard, will include unit test.

mike: rollback output: `autoscaler-service v2.1.2 deployed (3/3 replicas ready)`

sophia: autoscaler logs after rollback show headroom calc back to normal, scaling actions resuming.

sophia: new autoscaler status:
```
desired_replicas: 128
current_replicas: 92
scale_state: scaling_up
```

kevin: infra provisioning ramping. queue length trending down from 1400 -> 520 in last 7m.

arya: customer impact note: hosted API /v1/generate saw ~15% elevated 5xx rate for 22m, elevated p95 latency 1.5-2x for same window. No data exfil or errors beyond increased errors/retries. Marking severity: Major. Notify support and SOC.

priya: posting interim incident summary to #incidents and pinging Support for high-touch customers.

priya: support ping sent. list: acme, brightside, standupai (top 10 by qps) — 3rd party retries might cause duplicate billing risk, flagging billing.

mike: PR for fix merged and will be deployed as v2.1.3-hotfix in ~8m. adding guard `if denom==0 -> assume headroom_max`.

devops-bot: Deploy event: autoscaler-service v2.1.3-hotfix deployed at 2025-06-02T03:32Z

sophia: monitoring: after hotfix, autoscaler stable, no further headroom locks.

kevin: queue length now 82, current_replicas 128, target throughput restored. 5xx rates back to baseline over last 6m.

arya: nice work. next actions:
- mike: follow up postmortem on autoscaler rollouts and add canary checks for headroom calc (owner: mike)
- priya: confirm notify top customers and do communications (owner: priya)
- sophia: add alert guard to detect `scale_locked` state and auto-escalate earlier (owner: sophia)
- kevin: verify infra quotas and add buffer runway for host pools (owner: kevin)

mike: will open/assign postmortem doc and timeline. ETA draft in 2 hours.

priya: handing off to @kevin for monitoring + cleanup. I'm pausing active ops, will join for postmortem.

kevin: taking over monitoring and cleanup. will scale down gradually when safe and ensure billing flags for affected tenants.

arya: thanks team. closing PD-4492 after stabilization. final note: cause = autoscaler v2.1.3 headroom calc bug -> division by zero -> scale lock -> backlog. Mitigation = manual scale, routing fallback, rollback + hotfix. Lessons: stricter canaries for autoscaler logic, automated detection of locked scale state.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4492 resolved by eng-oncall. closed at 2025-06-02T03:49Z

incident-bot: Incident summary posted to #postmortems/pd-4492 (draft).
